text: Fun, good graphics, love if I happen to get disconnected from Wi-Fi and lose connection, my rewards are still there and added to my account when I'm able to log back in again! BUT, they are making it harder to complete albums, and this current album has so many gold stickers (more than any other) so I hope they give us more Gold Blitzes this season

Completely pay to play after leveling a bit. Impossible to advance or win in any event without spending money. The algorithms have gotten much worse. It changes with each event to land on mostly dead tiles. Any wheel spin feature lands on whatever the minimum is. The higher amount of dice you use per roll increases the chances of landing on dead tiles. This game used to be better, but now free to play players get nothing out of this game anymore.

The game starts off fun enough....you get through some levels and you are able to have a bit of fun while playing...but, like any game, this one's goal is to draw you in to spend money...and we aren't talking 2-3 dollars. We are talking HUNDREDS of dollars. Lots of mini games in the main game...now, of course you need to land on certain squares to get points and items to complete the mini-games. Just know that they change the algorithm for rolling dice on these games non stop. STAY AWAY!!!

i do enjoy this game, I just wish it was better. I've been seeing a lot of sketchy things about it on YouTube (bundle prices changing depending on the person buying it and how much they've spent), and for the 2 years I've been playing it, I have always struggled keeping up in events and have NEVER been able to finish sticker albums. i would recommend not spending your money on it, it'll make future bundles more expensive supposedly, and you still won't complete sticker sets.

I liked this game until I started leveling up really quickly by playing side games. Now it's refusing to give me rewards. I'm +200 points to get 34 million, which puts me at the next level. Reached out to support with screenshots. They gave me a basic trouble shoot text. Tried everything and still not rewards. They said they would look into it, but that doesn't help me get my past due reward or whatever the next one would be. Fun until you start doing well. Same issues 11/2024, 5/2025.

I think there's close to zero substance in this game. It works, runs decently, and has things to collect, but it doesn't feel like anything but a treadmill that wants your money every 10 minutes. The game wants you to connect with others to push progress in the hope that someone is willing to feed it cash, but it is ultimately not worthwhile to play

Rather boring game, not much to do, CONSTANT in-app purchase nags, but no ads though. Graphics look really nice though. Update: This game is 100% pay to win for all the multiplayer features and there are MANY whales in this game. Also you'll never complete any of the challenges or sticker collections until you give them money and lots of it. If it wasn't for the fact I play this with some friends I would have ditched this game a while ago.

It is a lot of fun. It's definitely pay to win though. You will have a very hard time collecting anything unless you pay money. Recently they done an update and added the tycoon tab. That's even more spending. They do give you a free spin and gift in the tycoon area so that was cool. It was cool. Then my tycoon disappeared. Some people can still go to the tycoon page and some can't. Maybe they will fix it. Waiting to see if I go up or down in stars for this review.

lots of errors and mishaps on monopolys side and very little compensation to the players, even when broke down in detail of everything. right before the end of an album too. pricing on things very dramatically, if you purchase stuff with money they keep raising the prices on future ones, like collecting shields and landing on rail road, piggy bank etc. its a good way to waste some time but unless your willing to spend $100s of dollars you wont get anywhere. esp with all the glitches and errors.

This is a fun little game. Good graphics and nice sound direction. Not too frustrating, but there are a couple things I'm not a fan of. Every time I start the game or run out of dice getting 4-5 popups asking me to buy more is excessive. The cost of dice is way too high. I did buy 1 dice pack using my play credit to support the game since I found it fun. The cost should be $1 for 100 then I'd be more likely to buy more.

This game is a joke. You need SO much money to build and then they pretty much require that you get friends in order to get that money but then these "friends" are the ones that attack and steal from you. REPEATEDLY! I just had ONE friend attack me 16 times in less than 10 minutes. How is that fair? You don't get enough spins to make enough money to rebuild or get shields. It's ridiculous. Games are supposed to be fun and this one is just inferiating.

Fun for a month and then gets annoying with excessive animations. At least you can turn off the emojis because those are terrible. I usually have limited down time to play. All the excessive animations on start up and in game play eat up 1/2 of my game play time. Wish you would do like other games and give us an option to turn them off. As a result I can only play for about a month and then have to stop and wait at least 6 months before I can play again.

gameplay seems to have been modified... I used to be able to finish every task, even the team tasks, get them all done, past several months, they're impossible to even get halfway through, frustrating. Game has been modified so that you can almost get a task, but to finish it, you need to buy dice, etc. spend money, didn't used to be that way,. you could get things done, you can complete tasks, you can level up, all without investing any money. now it seems to be tweaked that you cannot. not fun

Love it. Have been playing it on my tablet since its release. Now added to the Android phone. The game runs slower and will freeze when playing on the tablet. however, not sure if that's due from a storage issue or is the game lagging. Was going to remove and delete it. But! New Simpsons Theme is Great! I'll deal with the lagging..Maybe The issue will be resolved. give it a shot! 🤙

Very disappointed with how this season has started. Getting prizes has been so much harder and a lot more wanting us to pay to win. I've played for 3 years. I've never completed an album and I've also never struggled this much to get tokens and shields. I'm just disappointed and care less and less to play because I see no point unless I spend money.

not sure what people are talking about about not being able to level up or whatever. I'm on level 24 and haven't spent any $$ on in app purchases. I've been able to play non stop with the free items that's given. not really sure what others are talking about not being able to level or complete sticker packs. it's an alright game to play all the levels seem to be the same other than the costs of building your lands which like all other games the higher the level the more the prices are.

Can basically get no where on this game unless you pay money, then when you do, you still don't get anything. The extra little games and prizes and stickers to get more dice, you'll constantly be spending more to try and get what you need. You will always be missing one thing. Yes you can ask others, but rarely do they have it either and they have it to where the ones you need, you can't trade.

played for well over a year now, they have made it almost impossible to complete an album. They tell you that dice rolls, card packs and such are random, but it's a lie. Even purchasing things doesn't improve your odds. It's turned into a time killer instead of a fun game. It's become another money grab game. As for trading stickers for one's you don't have is also almost impossible, because you hardly ever get duplicate stickers worth value, tons of 1,2 and 3 star stickers, nothing higher.

Has the worst customer service ever. The game has been made where it's nearly impossible to retrieve old account progress and purchases back because of the impossible list of things you need in order to recover it. The only way to recover an old account is through customer service and they ended my conversation without answering any of my questions and continues to be short and unhelpful. A shame because I really liked this game but I don't see a point in redoing everything I built up.

It's still a good game, but because you guys decided to put a cap on passive rolls to 400 (which i was at around 800) it made this game not enjoyable. Like if you dont spend money on the game, its hard to get through even 1 board, and it seams your never able to get your dice count up enough for the 50 times multiplier. I feel like if you raise the cap from 400 to 800, a lot more people would stay because thats when you can hit the 50 times. I have more to say but dont have enough space!

This game is a really fun game. i don't get many ads. It's a very big time killer. You even get to play with friends! if you go on the train button and land on it, you can take away other people's buildings on their board, the person I got was my own uncle! so if you have friends, you might be able to meet them on monopoly. and there are literally not ads, I have not gotten any ads!!!!!! this game is a must have thank you. So much Monopoly Go!!!

The game used to be fun but now it seems nothing more than a money grab with tons of cheaters and scammers. The game constantly has annoying purchase pop ups. On top of being greedy, they allow cheaters to continue playing preventing regular players from being able to fairly progress in team games like the racing event. Three days of "competing" against a cheating team with no help from the game. They tell you better luck next time. Customer service sucks and never actually fixes the issue.

It is a rich person's game. Unless you pay to play you do not progress in the game very fast. You spend all your time trying to earn money to buy property and then once you have your hotels built the color wheel takes all your hotels off the board. This doesn't allow you to collect much from other players or continue to progress to a high class. Not fair and not even close to the actual board game.

The mechanics are easy to figure out and smooth. The graphics are great The one star is the gameplay itself. There's no way to casually play and win anything. All the events are rigged in way to never successfully finish them unless you get around their "normal" gameplay. Casual players will never finish albums/events so don't even bother downloading it. Also their offers are shady, the price (if you spend your money) is different then anothers price. Yours may say $5, same thing $2 for them.

Love this game....though it is pretty expensive to continue playing as the levels progress. I've played for almost 2 yrs and spent enough on dice that I am embarrassed to list the amount. But this game is addictive and one of the only games where you can make "friends" with total strangers. It makes the game more engaging and the new chat app has only enhanced the game. Give it a try!

My favorite addition lol. Collecting card packs is one of my favorite features. I also love how every few months there is a new theme I started playing in the middle of the Disney theme but, have to say I absolutely love the Simpsons theme better. landing on free parking and having to roll the dice and miss the booby traps is pretty suspenseful. I can't wait to see what theme is next.

That last update rendered the game useless. It wouldn't let me play without updating and afterwards just sat there saying it's taking a bit, just wait. Closing and reopening dozens of times didn't help. There's no issue with my phone's memory or anything else. The only way to play was to uninstall then reinstall starting all over from scratch. It's pathetic.

This game isn't as enjoyable as it used to be. I was ready to quit, but I do love the Simpsons so I've stuck around and there HAVE been fun new side games as part of this promo. Fun to play it keeps you coming back!!! Great, fun, addictive game!! Unfortunately, it is yet another one of those games that are HIGHLY stacked to people who pay to play. The dice, sticker, and coin packages are INSANELY expensive. The 2nd time tech support said there wasn't anything they could do to help me... basically leaving me to start all over, I have been playing almost a year at this point, I'm not starting over. Very poor support

I do enjoy this game, it's just very very difficult to get what you need to finish the challenges/games that need to be finished and end up spending way too much money on. I love this game! Problem is there is a set of 15 or so cards everyone is after, they are very rare so you lose all you have before getting the 162. Uninstalled as about to lose them all. Alot in other groups feel the same way.

It seems I've got to the point that playing any further is useless. The higher you go, the more unachievable everything is. Instead of rewarding the people who enjoy playing the game, they make it less possible to continue without paying. You never get new stickers. The builds are over priced, rolls non-existent. Just not fun anymore. Thankfully, there are tons of similar games out there, and I have moved on from this one.

Let's make this very clear. This is slot machine in disguise. Give it a month, maybe even less for some, and you'll be putting money in to get the chance of getting a reward or finish off your landmarks. These words come from experience, I've spend £150+ and for what? Some sticker packs to complete an album for more money to complete a never ending board. It'll be interesting to see the response from the devs but please turn your cards off while playing so you save your money!

Fun. But it's very repeatable, So It gets boring after a while great work to the developers! But I'm just bored with already. Just going around and around. And pretty much the same thing over and over again. So sorry but it's not for Me. Also the regeneration of the Dice Is Very!! slow and you don't get very many rolls unless you spend real money. And that's not happening! So bye have fun spending your money on Monopoly board game!! Which I have Also if I wanted to play. Lol.

It was fun. I'd accumulated so much dice money etc. I was over level 1000 but today it glitched. I couldn't do anything couldn't access anything. So I uninstalled hoping to fix it. No you do that you go back to the start. Everything you gained you lose. That was the hardest blow of all. I've played heaps of games but not one that doesn't remember you account.

I am done with this game. It was enjoyable and fun at one point but that was before their improvements and changes. It has become a money grab where one needs to buy rolls in order to get anywhere in it. It never used to be like that. I am lvl 10,856 and finding it very difficult to just complete some of the daily goals now without having to buy rolls. I have been unable to complete daily "upgrade landmarks" goals on the 10 rolls per hour that I get and miss out on in-game rewards. Not fun

Decided to come back to this game. whilst it is fun, performance on a Pixel 6 Pro 12GB RAM isn't the best. Moreover, the game is riddled with popup microtransactions. It gets pretty annoying when you finish with rolls and a popup saying "buy more" appears. Some mornings I just want to get the rolls done, but have to spend a few minutes clicking "no" on all the popup "buy this". I hate that design philosophy. This also goes for the mini events...

When you break it down, it's just pressing 'roll' - the game plays itself. More so when you choose 'auto-roll'! Might as well put your feet up. What's the point? You accumulate money, can't seem to choose what to buy, build pointless structures and try to do others in. The train station 'games' are easy and the same every time. There's no fun, challenge or education here. Add in the ridiculous pay-for-content stuff and you've got a dreadful so-called game. Deleted within the hour.

The game is very fun but it takes too long to receive the dice. Not only that, it keeps giving you more and more extra stickers, even if you exchange them, it gives back the same sticker. Can you pls upgrade this game to make it more fun and not to annoy people? What's the point giving the same extra sticker card but cannot be used? Why not create a group in the game where people can trade with each other, as opposed to needing to join a Facebook group to trade? Gonna uninstall soon!!! BYEEEE 🙃

I thought this was going to be at least slightly close to the original Monopoly experience, but after playing, this is just coinmaster with a monopoly skin on it, the gameplay gets repetitive and boring really quickly and they are aware of it as they are very generous when you start playing to get you to pay for more rolls as you'll want more in that moment. Also, why force to use a Facebook account to save progress when a lot more options are available? (such as Google account or Play games)

Rating this game a 2 because it is fun and keeps me going for long periods of time, but I am concerned that somehow just as I need something the dice just won't land where I need it. Wasting a lot of my dices/ rolls. I almost feel like I'm being cheated out of a win and it gets very frustrating. Also, if you can please make the golden blitz available every now and then would be great because you sit with so much duplicates and you can't even gift, sent or exchange with other friends.

Hello [insert name]! Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us. Of course, we hear you (but the dev team doesn't), and we will be looking for opportunities to improve our game further to increase profitable engagement at the expense of gameplay.

Was great in the beginning, but getting a bit boring the further you level up. Never get any new cards. Same gold cards over and over again, but you can't trade them. You should be at least able to do 1 gold card trade a day or something.. so you have a fair go at completing the sticker album! And if you complete a board, you only get 50 dice whether you're on level 2 or 200. Bit bs as you need A LOT more money/rolls to do the higher levels.

Many players can no longer make any progressions; the dice given were pretty insufficient despite the level you are currently at. It used to be a fun and good game to spend time with, but now it is getting more and more of a "money-consuming" game. Don't even mention we have to collect stickers to complete the albums when you keep getting the same stickers. The developer has really completely rigged the game. I must say that I am hugely disappointed and upset.

The game is good no glitches no struggling, however it happens from time to time just as any other applications. The most frustrating of the game is that I have been playing the game for some time now (longer than 1 year) and have not once been able to complete an album. You can not complete any mini games or partnerships. Seems the only way you can progress is to make a purchase. This makes one doubt the actual game and make one consider deleting it.

Loved this game to begin with, after some time though you soon realise that it's just another typical game that doesn't cater for people's financial status. If you wanna do well in this game then you're gonna have to spend some money. The events and challenges are ridiculous, because they give you a small time frame in which to complete the tasks and you never actually do it, you only ever get really close. How you gonna play with no dice? Oh I know just buy some! - well we can't all do that! 😔

I downloaded this game in 10/23... deleteed it and I was pretty high on the ladder also. I just reinstalled it again a couple of days ago. This game is fun with or without real friends. This game is fun and way better than the real game you wanted to flip over. 💕

I absolutely love this game and have been playing it everyday for almost a year. Unfortunately today after the new update it does not want to open anymore. I have un-installed and installed the game again. My Internet connection is also good but it still does not want to work. The same speech bubble pops up saying: "We're sorry, an error occurred requiring the game to restart." and it just restarts over and over again. So disappointed 😞

If you enjoy wasting your time to end up incredibly disappointed, this game is for you! It is nearly impossible to progress without spending real money, eight dice every hour gets you no where. Not to mention the impossible team events (the Spooky Car event? Trash!). I spent over 17000 dice, took first in a tournament and got nothing but duplicate cards, and was only able to complete ONE car out of four. It's not even enjoyable anymore, which is why I'm deleting! Don't waste your time!

This game used to be very fun when I first played, but recently greed has got the best of them. Less stickers in sticker packs, events becoming harder with new impossible designs in the peg-e for example. The further you go up in the levels, the harder the game gets with far less dice. In order to actually get anywhere with this game, you would have to spend ridiculous amounts of money to get any sort of reward. Its really a shame as I enjoyed this game far more when I first started playing.

My experience is simply this. I downloaded it through mistplay. For the tokens. From the beginning it was maddening. Endless pop-ups, for additional purchases. Click this click that. Every single time. I cannot Imagine in any of my wildest dreams someone who made this game, actually played this game. Monopoly is a core memory for me. On my worst day, on my worst month of my worst year I could design a better idea than this, coin master(?) rip off. Thanks for ruining decades of happiness.

Great game play, but the pop-ups are infuriating. If I didn't want to buy more rolls or packages at the start of the game, I'm not going to want them at any other point either, and if I so, I'll go looking for them. Suggest a 'don't show me this again button' even if it's just good for that use of the game and you have to select it again the following time you play, it'd be better than getting the same pop ups (up to 7 in a row sometimes!) Every time you get low on dice.

Errors occur during pivotal moments of game play and customer service does nothing about it even when I provide a screen recording of the issue. Edit Nov. 24,2024. The game doesn't offer all players the same options. I was only a few digs away from finishing the dig event, which would have given me the last sticker I needed to finish my entire album. I used up all my dice for the event in addition to spending money to buy more dice. Couldnt finish the event. Worst game ever. Don't play it.

So fun at first. Once I got into a higher level it turned stupid. Yes I did purchase a few things but don't scam me, I won't be paying hundreds of dollars to keep up, the worst thing is that even when I do purchase to get stickers, they won't give me anything to complete the album, I've been stuck in the same place for over two weeks. Deleting it.

I enjoyed this game for a year, but it became a daily obsession. There's no gambling addiction warning, so if anybody sees this that battles with spending money to get ahead/ will want to finish events.. I'd highly recommend not getting sucked into it. You literally see the game forcing spins to miss good slots and encourages you with game packs all the time, making it feel like spending £10 - £60 on a bunch of cards and dice in a game is reasonable. If your kids play.. beware! Had to delete it!

Yeah it's good but not that kind of better. The dice you get is limited and the boring thing is that all the goes around same. Get dice, money and upgrade the same sht everytime nothing else. I thought they would have some sort of upgrades that can help players to get more dice,money easily. I barely can play for a "long" time. Because the dice get used up quickly and the rewards are low. Also I don't understand when is the time of shutdown and bank heist. The word "fun" don't go much with game.

Too many "X" to click when opening the game. Also they say "game will play by itself", no it wont. Every 15 seconds yoi have to interact with the game even if you are on auto-roll. So thats a big lie. I cant let my game roll dices and do something else. There's a lot of pop ups when we open the game and when we run off dices, but others than that it's fun even if it's very just the same over and over again.

This monoploy is really well paced, great art style and the game mechanics are simple. I only started a few days ago and the amount of satisfaction and dopamine (the feel good chemical in your brain) that this game gives me I just wanna keep playing. Also, the timeout on the dice isn't like waiting an hour for a single die, you get five so on the lowest bet you get five rolls every hour and it only takes about 8 hours, at the level I'm at, to have full rolls and play again!

U take the issue of reroll or other trick too serious. Just let it be. Those who want to learn just do. Those who doesnt can just play through the right way. Afterall, its just a game. Plus, the number of dices provided was too small, and u make it hard to land on the specific landmark everytime theres an event. U guys just want us to buy from u, buying a small amount of dices with higher prices and cover it with a statement "we want a fair games, that why we are fixing those bugs". It sucks.

There should be a system to exchange the stickers inside the game, the facebook group is disgraceful. I wasn't using it anymore, then I had to go back with my account and it was a big disappointment. You have to talk to other people, who sometimes are weirdos, screenshot your stickers, find someone willing to trade, exchange ids, that's so much work for nothing sometimes, and most people are really there for.the freebies. Terrible idea using social media to outsource a game feature.

These past few days I felt like the game server was really lag. Most of the time I took up to 5 whole minutes just to load everything, and yet some of the in-game icons were not responsive and have to wait a couple of minutes more. Its annoying. I have like 15 minutes of break at work and wanted to play some monopoly, and it took like minutes to load. At first I thought my connection was the problem, but when I tried to play other game, they loaded up just fine.

This game is engaging yet so very frustrating. Twice I've lost out on rewards from updating a property. No glitch in the game, it just didn't pay me. Another time, I was to receive my Comm Chest, and the game froze. I had to do a hard close and never received the prize. There have been several other times where I was to get items for the group challenges and got nothing. Get only 1 mitt but need 20 to use towards the bake off challenge made me close to deleting and still might yet.

I like this game, but it's pretty clear what their motive is, your money. When you load the game up you have to go through 2 or 3 different "offers" trying to you purchase something before you've even begun to play. This is highly annoying and is slowly making me not want to play. There are plenty of ways to earn dice rolls that aren't paid for, but, like all mobile games, micro transactions are the quickest.

Completing 1 board, gives you 50 dices. As you advance further into the game, I'm at 256, it is still 50 dices. Like inflation, that 50 dices is so so small, that you cannot even upgrade a single landmark. Same goes with the regeneration of dices, it is cap at 80 dices and only 8 rolls per hour. What's the point, that 80 rolls will not get you anything and you'll quickly run out of dices. The fun is all gone, now that's left is deleting the game.

I'm forced to comment here because the developers and technicians ignore my complaint on the app and via the website. I spent so much money on this game, so I'm very disappointed. When I completed the album the first round, all sets still showed as "completed" even though there were clearly no stickers in the sets. There are big tournaments happening, so I'm playing as usual, and I'm getting stickers. I completed two sets again, but no rewards. I feel demotivated from trading, even.

This game is the biggest scam of all time! Prizes never equal to the amount of dice spent. The game is rigged. Never landing on the tiles you need when you are using big dice numbers. The moment you use 1 dice or 3 you land on the tiles needed. Also, the heists! Can we talk about the fact they are predetermined. Cards have been difficult to gain. With the removal/change of vaults and wilds, it's harder and harder to complete album. Don't let Scopely take your money. Find another game.

Sometimes you can build up your £, leave the game for a few hours, come back, to see your money is still there. Other times - since the last update - you can build up millions only to go back an hour later and most of it has gone! Where's the fun in that? Are we supposed to stay attached to it 24 hours a day? Not good. Then there are the challenges, impossible to finish unless you pay ALOT for extra credits. Why would you buy credits anyway, if someone can steal it all? Tiring of this. Not fun

Constant glitches, paid for dice but didn't get the EXTRA that it states you will get. Most 5 star cards are impossible to win. I have spent over $300.00 and refuse to spend another penny on this game. What a frustrating game, it's nearly impossible to finish a full set of cards. I have been playing for a month and have not completed the album. Can't even get enough dice to continue to play and let's not talk about the money that it cost to build. Mr.M at least make it a fair game.

REALLY dull. You just keep clicking until you run out of rolls but essentially it's just an idle clicker game. Click. Get some cash. Upgrade buildings that do nothing. When all upgraded move on to another level. Yawn. Occasionally try to break someone's buildings but 80% of the time they have a shield. Sometimes u click on boxes to match 3 items but just get some cash. No skill required. This is nothing like monopoly. Dodgey so many 5* reviews as looking at last 50 most r 1-3*. Suspicious.

Fun for a month, good time killer. You can't get far though, for example, I spend my time building again what other players destroy, over and over, and if I don't build, they steal my money, so I can't build anything.. Thats quite annoying. On the other hand, collecting cards is the hardest thing ever, I keep collecting them but some decided to not show up on the packs I open, what a surprise. I think this is supposed to make you buy stuff that is so overpriced but I won't pay a dime.

When I saw the new update, I thought it would improve my experience. But after a while, I noticed that the value of normal stickers has gone down as safe prices increased. Golds are no longer available in normal packs. Chances of getting 4 star on wheel has obviously been manipulated to decrease. Worst part is, I genuinely don't think there is a F2P way to get gold 4&5 stars. Meaning it's impossible to complete 8/21 packs w/o spending, on top of the low odds of getting even normal 4&5 stars.

Edited. I've been playing for a while now. Although the game is fun (and addictive), it's gotten to the point that if you don't spend a bunch of money, you'll get nowhere. Constantly getting gold duplicates that you can't trade, not landing on the spaces you need to earn points in tournaments/events, and it's full of bad luck rolls even though they ensure us it's all random. The only way to actually get random rolls/land on what you need was to play offline but they took that away now too.

I'm pretty upset. Since the update this morning, I haven't been able to get on all day until now. It just now finally loaded. I went from 2nd place in the standings (lost all the rewards for being in 2nd place!) and lost my login day streak (even though I was on it yesterday), and none of the buttons are working. Not impressed.

The game is fun, but it's incredibly pay-to-win once you reach the late game stages. Unless you fork out for the in-game packs, you're pretty much constantly waiting to get your dice back, and you only get 80 dice, which is practically nothing for the higher level players. I get that the developers need to make their money, but the packs aren't even reasonably priced. Considering what you get in them, they're easily the most overpriced in-game purchases of any mobile game I've played.

12th april 2026 update. so, this billionaire company decides to not allow emulators... If i could give this app 0 stars I would, this is a very inconsiderate money hungry move on Scopely's side,, MANY people might not have access to a proper smart device or they want the convenience of an emulator to enjoy the game. This is a terrible mistake on their side

It was really fun at first. You could actually complete sticker albums and challenges. In the recent treasure digging tournament, I used over 20,000 rolls, and I couldn't complete the event. Twenty. Thousand. Rolls. It's rigged for failure now. Most of those rolls were from completing the sticker album 2 albums ago (when it was still possible to complete). You would have to spend over $800 to buy 20,000 rolls in the game store, and that still would not be enough to finish the event.Uninstalling.

Really disappointed in the latest partner event. They said it was fixed but it wasn't. Used thousands of dice. I got a random "gift" as compensation (the minimum, according to other players) but my partner, who is the one negatively affected, got nothing. Also have been trying to connect my game to FB for months and have contacted support multiple times and still no resolution.

The game is very well made, but, people, if a game becomes a burden is not a game anymore. Is not fun anymore. I get that you want people to buy dice and stuff, but lots are quiting the game, because no one wants to spend time playing and not getting any reward or not finishing any event. What to say about the 8 dice per hour... What's the purpose to install if you get to play 5 minutes a day?🙄

The was great. I loved the game! Trading stickers was a nightmare with all the scammers trying to sell you the stuff. DO NOT CLICK ON ANY OF THOSE LINKS. My phone got hacked and taken over control where the scammers kept adding themselves to my friend's list and posting stuff without my consent. It got so bad, to the point that I couldn't even log in to my Facebook, without having to change my password upteen times! I had enough. I had to delete the game.

It's an OK game with friends, and card trading is a nice addition. However, the mini competitions are very much geared to those who pay to win the game. Within the first hour, the top spot was taken by someone who had ammased over 50 thousand points, and the 2nd and 3rd were not far behind. This means the top slots and sometimes the top 20, where the best prizes are, are very much off limits to those who do not pay.

The game is a sham with the goal of taking advantage of elderly people. That's it. The pop-ups trying to get you to make in-game purchases are the worst I've ever seen in a game. There are zero rewards, and you gain absolutely nothing playing it. Late game is nigh unplayable with the same dice advancements as the beginning of the game, but you're spending thousands of times more in-game cash - does that make sense? Overall, potentially the most corrupt mobile gaming experience I've ever had.

It's fun, but it's almost impossible now to complete events or albums as a f2p player. When I first started playing, yeah, it was tough to do these things, but it was still achievable. Takes the fun right out of it. Maybe dial back the difficulty and let us get gold cards more often again. Or maybe even make gold card trading more often. Idk, man. But I'm done after this album. Thanks for the memories.

As others have said- the game is fixed not random. I have only found this out after moving up through the levels of the game. You you would think they would come up with a way to make levels harder without fixing the game. That's just frustrating and nothing to do with any type of skill. Oh and it's full of people that openly admit to cheating!

For the fun factor, this game is not bad, creativity, themes, mini games. only thing is the game is definitely rigged and tons of bots are added to force you to buy packs in order to advance in it. Nearly impossible to lose your 1st spot in mini games in a minute by 5000, sometimes more. Cards are not evenly distributed and you'll notice you will rarely get what you need from what they give you. If you get angry at games from that don't play it, they're a company after all. Needs to be more fun.

Becomes very boring and slow after a while if you don't put any cash into the game. The micro transactional pop ups when you open the game up are annoying, as well as when you get below 10 dice, the pop ups will pop up TWICE (when you're under 10 dice and when you have no dice). Super annoying and doesn't make me want to play more. Last thing; overpriced. Not worth spending money. They charge too much for next to nothing. Save your money and spend it elsewhere. 3/10 game in my opinion.

The newest version's additions are set to BOOST your balance with more zeros and ensure a smoother, bug-free gameplay experience! My game is not bug free. My vault is currently bugged. The events are bugged. All I'm getting is duplicate gold stickers. All I see from other social media sites is complaints about this game. 500 dice for compensation for a broken partners event wasn't enough for more than half of the players. I spent way more than 500 dice as did many others.

It seems the longer you have played the game, the more disadvantaged you are with completing anything. Collecting stickers, completing sets, completing albums, daily challenges and mini games, etc. You don't have to spend money to play. However, if you want to complete anything, it's the only way to achieve it.

I have to edit my review from 2 years ago. Over the last 2 years, I have uninstalled this game and reinstalled it. I've been playing it again and let me tell you, this game hasn't changed. They let you progress just far enough that you are forced to spend money on in-app purchases. The in-app purchases are not cheap! If you do purchase anything it's for very limited game play. Not worth it at all. Gold card trading is frustrating. Why even have a second bonus album if no one sees it. Disgusting

Everything feels so preset. I spent over 1,000 dice and couldn’t even land on a single event icon. For the current event, I’ve not once managed to trigger the Mega Bonus. Honestly, it’s frustrating. No wonder fewer and fewer people want to play. Dice are never enough, and when you move to another map, the same dice pool applies. Plus, the dice limit is so low. If this keeps up, the game is going to crash sooner or later.

Monopoly GO is a fast-paced mobile twist on the classic board game. Its colorful visuals, mini-events, and daily rewards make it addictive and easy to enjoy in short bursts. However, the heavy reliance on in-app purchases and limited free rolls can frustrate players over time. Great for casual fun, but not for those seeking the full Monopoly strategy experience. Overall, it’s a polished yet pay-heavy game.

Money grab game. Impossible to play if you don't pay. Especially with sticker albums. Fifth time in a row where I need ONE sticker to complete the event. Then they charge you an exhorbitant amount if you want to finish the set. After 3 years of playing I'm done. Deleted the game and advising my friends to do the same. Very addictive and fun IF you're willing to SPEND way too much money on overpriced deals.

Changing my review to 2 stars. I ultimately decided to delete the game. With each new round of special events/updates, the algorithm is made increasingly difficult and unlikely for the average player to complete. I felt the fun was taken out of it that way. I don't have to time to play on multiple devices and seeing as I only played with one account, I couldn't get myself the needed stickers or win any events.

Alright if you wanna climb up faster you need to pay a lot of money , i mean , you wait 1 hour to recharge 5 rolls that can be played in 15 seconds , what's the fun ?? You enter the app Rollin some dices in 1 min and keep staring at the phone screen just like that , the only thing i like about the game though , the fact that they can manipulate you to keep playing the game by some events , and ofcaurse you're not able to complete them cause you need to pay ..

This game is highly addictive in negative way. I could put it in one category with game slots. It is nice game though, but the way it is made, it compares to game slots. And with enormous amount of in game purchase pop ups, it makes you want to buy extra dice because you are so close to reach the target. And these deals to buy a dice pops up whenever you open app, there are at least 3 pop ups, then- every time you run out of the dice, immediately pop ups appear to offer you buy more dice.

It's an alright game. But I realised that the more you progress and the more friends you have, the more broke you'll be. Every day, i load into Monopoly Go, expecting to continue my progress from earlier. However, I load on just to see that my 1.5M has gone down to 45K in just a day. This means to grind all over again, and it just keeps happening. It's really annoying.

I don't understand why developers make a game that seems fun at first but becomes blatantly obvious that it is a cash grab. You have events that last hours and can never be completed. I started to notice that when you progress, everything becomes way more expensive, and you just can't get a head. Dice take way too long to generate, and I'm not buying stuff for this game because of this reason. Way to ruin a good game!

So giving a 2 star becasue although I love the game, when people send you cards they don't ALL arrive. I need 1 card to complete a set and someone sent said card and oh look it has NOT arrived 26 hours later!! It keeps saying, "there's been a problem"!! I've contacted support and still waiting for them to get back to me. I don't think it will be long and I will be deleting the game!!!

Clearly designed to catch people out and give money to Scopely. Far too many extra things when loading back into a game: multiple things trying to get you to buy bonus packs EVERY SINGLE TIME. And the cross moves to catch you out, sometimes at the bottom sometimes in the corner, and the next one has a price tag where you've just clicked, so be careful! Daily bonuses do a similar scummy thing. In game, whenever something happens, it takes ages, and the roll multiplier makes no sense.

The microtransactions (in-app payments) are a joke. They're so expensive and predatory. There is a cheat to get dice which loads of other players seem to be able to use, but it ruins the game for everyone else. You have very little chance of getting in the top 5 for most of the daily/2 day events. The stickers are ridiculous. You get the same ones continuously, even when opening high level packs. There are online groups where people try to SELL the stickers. Again. Ridiculous. Don't bother.

Good free to play game for doing house chores, just auto roll the dice and play the "shutdown" and "bank robbery" mini game when you land on the railroad house. Lots of events (daily), but those are all pay to win and to complete, but you can still get some good rewards. For my surprise, no ads for other games, but when you log in and when you expend all the dices, you get spammed to buy their own bundles.

As expected the 'game' is quite pushy kindly asking you for money for in-app purchases. It is obviously rigged making the player slightly frustrated so that they would finally give up their hard earned cash for a few more rolls. Other than that, the graphics are quite pretty, the bugs that I noticed along the way got patched shortly. Overall it's your average coin master reskin, but at least it has better graphics and is an ok time waster if you're into this type of stuff.

Prepare to be super annoyed. At first the game is super fun. But once you realise you can play for a few minutes only at a time cause you dont have rolls it becomes annoying unless you have money to buy buy buy. Thats all they want. Game has lots of potential but they are taking the fun out of it. Back to Candy Crush where I can at least sit down, relax and enjoy some game.

Just edited my review to 1 star. Game is stagnant as u go beyond a certain level as they intend for players to spend money to buy the in-game content. And even if u did buy, the chances of getting the stickers that you need are very, very low. Hence, it feels like a scam.
